notes.title: Update Highlights: Soul Bag, Visual Polish & Steam Cloud Support
notes.notes:
Update Highlights: Soul Bag, Steam Cloud, Visual Tweaks & Fixes

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621662/7d987dc38dd2c29a12ec7957185fec9bec472c96.gif
Weather upgrade

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621662/976a02f7283a3e514d9599d1f90b1211e1d4f2cc.png
New NPC: Spectral Demon

New Features & Improvements
🌧️ Weather Upgrades: Rain and snow have been redesigned to look more immersive and blend naturally into the world.  
🗃️ Steam Cloud Saves: Your progress is now safely synced with Steam Cloud! Jump between machines without losing your adventure.  
🎮 Manual FPS Limit: You can now manually set a maximum FPS from the options menu, giving you better control over performance.  
🌐 Instant Language Change: Switching languages now applies instantly—no need to hit "Save" or restart the game.  
🔔 Smoother Notifications: Notifications now appear neatly at the top right and have been fully reworked for clarity and speed.  
📜 Enhanced Dialogues: Campaign 1’s first quest has been improved with better-written lines and subtle text animations to convey emotions.  
👻 Soul Bag: A new quest item that lets you collect demon souls. These souls will be used to unlock sealed gates that lead to boss dungeons.  
💡 Floating Player Hints: New optional setting that reinforces warnings like "movement blocked" when managing inventory or skills.

Visual & UI Tweaks  
🎬 Credits screen.  
✨ Soul Collection FX: Added special effects when collecting demon souls to make the moment more satisfying.  
📝 Minor UI polish (e.g., opening chests now shows the correct localized text).

Balance Changes  
⚖️ Starting Items Adjusted: Attribute and skill recovery potions are no longer included in Campaign mode. They remain available when starting in Survival mode.

Bug Fixes  
🐞 Fixed: You could sharpen a weapon even if none was equipped.  
👀 Fixed: Combat effects from distant zones were sometimes visible when they shouldn't be.


Thanks!
